answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 46 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. The terrace register is checked at draw time, bridge lists the eligible set, and relic seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 46 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an farming party pays for every seat it wants. Bonded capital sits idle for 9 days. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
